en_title: DISCLOSEABLE AND CONNECTED TRANSACTION — ACQUISITION OF 60% EQUITY INTEREST IN HARBOUR LOGISTICS LIMITED
zh_title: 須予披露及關連交易 — 收購海港物流有限公司60%股權

expected_findings.en_snippet: The Consideration is HK$12.4 million, payable in cash on Completion.
expected_findings.zh_snippet: 代價為港幣1,210萬元，於完成時以現金支付。
expected_findings.note: HK$12.4 million in English; HK$12.1 million (1,210萬) in Chinese.

expected_findings.en_snippet: The Agreement follows a non-binding memorandum of understanding signed by the Company and the Vendor on 8 August 2026, the terms of which are superseded in their entirety by the Agreement.
expected_findings.zh_snippet: 本協議乃繼本公司與賣方於二零二六年八月八日簽署的具約束力諒解備忘錄後訂立，該備忘錄的條款已全部由本協議取代。
expected_findings.note: non-binding in English; 具約束力 (binding) in Chinese.

expected_findings.en_snippet: (c) the Independent Shareholders having approved the Acquisition at the EGM.
expected_findings.zh_snippet: (b) 賣方已就收購事項取得所有必要的第三方同意；
expected_findings.note: Condition (c) is absent from the Chinese list, which is relettered (a)(b)(c). zh_snippet is the nearest neighbour.

expected_findings.section: REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS OF THE ACQUISITION
expected_findings.en_snippet: Following Completion, the Group may consider further acquisitions in the logistics sector.
expected_findings.zh_snippet: 完成後，本集團將考慮於物流行業進行進一步收購。

expected_findings.en_snippet: The Company shall procure the payment of the Consideration from its internal resources.
expected_findings.zh_snippet: 本集團須以內部資源促使支付代價。
expected_findings.note: Obligation sits with the Company in English but the Group (本集團) in Chinese.
